<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SPIKE NEXT | Strategic Pathway for Innovation, Knowledge & Enterprise</title>
  <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <!-- Google Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans & Inter -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <!-- Lucide Icons -->
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>

  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      theme: {
        extend: {
          colors: {
            obsidian: '#06080D',
            obsidianElevated: '#0B0F19',
            obsidianSurface: '#121726',
            cardDark: '#161D2E',
            borderDark: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)',
            borderHighlight: 'rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.35)',
            // SPIKE Venture Studio
            spikeRed: '#E50914',
            spikeRedGlow: '#FF2E3E',
            // 1CMA / AIA Philippines
            cmaGold: '#D4AF37',
            cmaGoldGlow: '#F5D77F',
            cmaCrimson: '#8B0018',
            // Versa Ecosystem Accents
            versaCyan: '#00E5FF',
            versaEmerald: '#10B981',
            versaBlue: '#0284C7',
          },
          fontFamily: {
            heading: ['"Plus Jakarta Sans"', 'sans-serif'],
            sans: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'],
          },
          animation: {
            'glow-spin': 'spin 30s linear infinite',
            'float-slow': 'float 7s ease-in-out infinite',
            'pulse-glow': 'pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite',
          },
          keyframes: {
            float: {
              '0%, 100%': { transform: 'translateY(0px)' },
              '50%': { transform: 'translateY(-8px)' },
            },
            pulseGlow: {
              '0%, 100%': { opacity: '0.4' },
              '50%': { opacity: '0.8' },
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>

  <style>
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: #06080D;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #1E2638;
      border-radius: 9999px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: #E50914;
    }
    .hero-gradient-overlay {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, 
        rgba(6, 8, 13, 0.45) 0%, 
        rgba(6, 8, 13, 0.85) 60%, 
        #06080D 100%
      );
    }
    .glass-panel {
      background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.78);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }
    .glass-card-interactive {
      transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }
    .glass-card-interactive:hover {
      border-color: rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.5);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 36px -12px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.28);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .spike-glow {
      box-shadow: 0 0 32px -4px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.45);
    }
    .versa-badge-glow {
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px -2px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    }
    .video-vignette {
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(6, 8, 13, 0.9);
    }
  </style>

  <style id="theme-system">
    /* SPIKE NEXT visitor theme: dark remains the cinematic default. */
    body { transition: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease; }
    .theme-switch { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:9px 11px; border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.4); border-radius:12px; color:#e2e8f0; background:rgba(15,23,42,.6); cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0; }
    .theme-switch:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #e50914; outline-offset:3px; }
    .theme-switch .sun-icon { display:none; }
    body.theme-light .theme-switch .sun-icon { display:block; }
    body.theme-light .theme-switch .moon-icon { display:none; }
    body.theme-light { background:#f7f8fb !important; color:#263247; }
    body.theme-light nav { background:rgba(255,255,255,.96) !important; border-color:#e2e8f0 !important; }
    body.theme-light nav .text-white { color:#152033 !important; }
    body.theme-light nav .text-slate-300, body.theme-light nav .text-slate-400 { color:#475569 !important; }
    body.theme-light nav button.bg-spikeRed, body.theme-light nav button.bg-spikeRed * { color:#fff !important; }
    body.theme-light .theme-switch { color:#263247; background:#f1f5f9; border-color:#cbd5e1; }
    body.theme-light section, body.theme-light footer { background:#f7f8fb !important; border-color:#e2e8f0 !important; }
    body.theme-light section:nth-of-type(odd) { background:#eef2f7 !important; }
    body.theme-light section .glass-panel, body.theme-light section .bg-obsidianSurface,
    body.theme-light section .bg-obsidianElevated, body.theme-light section .bg-obsidian,
    body.theme-light footer .bg-obsidianSurface, body.theme-light footer .bg-obsidianElevated {
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.94) !important; border-color:#dce3ed !important;
      box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.04);
    }
    body.theme-light section .text-white, body.theme-light footer .text-white { color:#162235 !important; }
    body.theme-light section .text-slate-200, body.theme-light section .text-slate-300,
    body.theme-light section .text-slate-400, body.theme-light footer .text-slate-300,
    body.theme-light footer .text-slate-400, body.theme-light footer .text-slate-500 {
      color:#475569 !important;
    }
    body.theme-light section .text-slate-500, body.theme-light section .text-slate-600 { color:#64748b !important; }
    body.theme-light section button.bg-spikeRed, body.theme-light section button.bg-spikeRed *,
    body.theme-light section .bg-spikeRed button, body.theme-light section button.bg-amber-500,
    body.theme-light section button.bg-cmaGold { color:#fff !important; }
    body.theme-light section button.bg-cmaGold { color:#111827 !important; }
    body.theme-light section .border-slate-800, body.theme-light section .border-slate-700,
    body.theme-light footer .border-slate-800 { border-color:#dce3ed !important; }
    body.theme-light #signupModal .glass-panel, body.theme-light #videoModal .glass-panel { background:#fff !important; color:#1e293b; }
    body.theme-light #signupModal .text-white, body.theme-light #videoModal .text-white { color:#172033 !important; }
    body.theme-light #signupModal .text-slate-300, body.theme-light #signupModal .text-slate-400,
    body.theme-light #videoModal .text-slate-300 { color:#475569 !important; }
    body.theme-light #signupModal input, body.theme-light #signupModal select,
    body.theme-light #signupModal .bg-obsidianSurface { background:#f8fafc !important; color:#172033 !important; }
    body.theme-light #signupModal button.bg-spikeRed, body.theme-light #signupModal button.bg-spikeRed * ,
    body.theme-light #videoModal button.bg-spikeRed { color:#fff !important; }
    body.theme-light #mobileMenu { background:#fff !important; }
    body.theme-light .md\\:hidden.fixed.bottom-0 { background:rgba(255,255,255,.98) !important; border-color:#cbd5e1 !important; }
    body.theme-light .md\\:hidden.fixed.bottom-0 .text-white { color:#172033 !important; }
    body.theme-light .md\\:hidden.fixed.bottom-0 button.bg-spikeRed { color:#fff !important; }
    /* Hero remains cinematic/dark in both modes for video legibility. */
    body.theme-light header .text-white { color:#fff !important; }
    body.theme-light header .text-slate-300 { color:#e2e8f0 !important; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      body, .glass-card-interactive { transition:none !important; }
      .animate-glow-spin, .animate-ping, .animate-pulse { animation:none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body class="bg-obsidian text-slate-200 font-sans antialiased selection:bg-spikeRed selection:text-white pb-20 md:pb-0">

  <!-- ================= TOP NAVIGATION ================= -->
  <nav class="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-obsidian/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-borderDark transition-all duration-300">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 h-20 flex items-center justify-between">
      
      <!-- Brand Lockup: SPIKE + 1CMA -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3.5 sm:gap-5">
        <!-- SPIKE Starburst Logo -->
        <a href="#" class="flex items-center gap-2.5 group">
          <div class="relative w-8 h-8 flex-shrink-0">
            <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-spikeRed transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:rotate-45" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="currentColor">
              <rect x="44" y="5" width="12" height="90" rx="6" />
              <rect x="5" y="44" width="90" height="12" rx="6" />
              <rect x="44" y="5" width="12" height="90" rx="6" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" />
              <rect x="44" y="5" width="12" height="90" rx="6" transform="rotate(-45 50 50)" />
              <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="11" fill="#06080D" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-col">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 leading-none">
              <span class="font-heading font-extrabold text-xl tracking-tight text-white">SPIKE</span>
              <span class="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-spikeRed/20 text-spikeRed font-bold border border-spikeRed/40">NEXT</span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[9px] tracking-[0.22em] font-medium uppercase text-slate-400 mt-1">Venture Studio</span>
          </div>
        </a>

        <!-- Elegant Vertical Separator -->
        <div class="h-6 w-[1px] bg-slate-800"></div>

        <!-- 1 Matunog District (1CMA) AIA Lockup -->
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <!-- 1CMA Crown Symbol -->
          <svg class="w-6 h-6 sm:w-7 sm:h-7 flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none">
            <path d="M15 72 L85 72 L80 78 L20 78 Z" fill="#D4AF37" />
            <polygon points="50,14 53,24 63,24 55,30 58,40 50,34 42,40 45,30 37,24 47,24" fill="#E50914" />
            <path d="M50 28 L35 70 L48 70 L50 35 L52 70 L65 70 Z" fill="#E50914" />
            <path d="M18 42 L28 70 L34 70 L25 45 Z" fill="#D4AF37" />
            <path d="M82 42 L72 70 L66 70 L75 45 Z" fill="#D4AF37" />
            <path d="M22 45 L32 68 L28 68 Z" fill="#8B0018" />
            <path d="M78 45 L68 68 L72 68 Z" fill="#8B0018" />
          </svg>
          <div class="hidden sm:flex flex-col leading-tight">
            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-white tracking-wide">1 MATUNOG DISTRICT</span>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">1CMA · AIA Philippines</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Center Desktop Navigation -->
      <div class="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-7 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
        <a href="#audiences" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Venture Tracks</a>
        <a href="#diagnostic" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Diagnostic</a>
        <a href="#ladder" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">SPIKE / RA-SPIKE</a>
        <a href="#ecosystem" class="hover:text-white transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span>Platform Stack</span>
          <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-versaCyan animate-pulse"></span>
        </a>
        <a href="#cma" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Cebu Agency Hub</a>
      </div>

      <!-- Action Cluster -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button id="themeToggle" class="theme-switch" type="button" aria-label="Switch to light theme" aria-pressed="false" title="Switch light/dark theme">
          <svg class="moon-icon" aria-hidden="true" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20.9 13A9 9 0 0 1 11 3.1 9 9 0 1 0 20.9 13Z"/></svg>
          <svg class="sun-icon" aria-hidden="true" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2m0 16v2M4.93 4.93l1.42 1.42m11.3 11.3 1.42 1.42M2 12h2m16 0h2M4.93 19.07l1.42-1.42M17.66 6.34l1.41-1.41"/></svg>
          <span class="hidden sm:inline text-[11px]" id="themeToggleText">Dark</span>
        </button>
        <!-- Powered by Versa subtle pill -->
        <a href="#ecosystem" class="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-700/80 text-[10px] text-slate-400 hover:border-versaCyan/40 hover:text-white transition-all">
          <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-versaCyan"></span>
          <span>Versa Tech</span>
        </a>

        <button onclick="openVideoModal()" class="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white glass-panel hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all border border-slate-700/80">
          <i data-lucide="play" class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-spikeRed fill-spikeRed"></i>
          <span>Watch 60s Reel</span>
        </button>

        <button onclick="openModal('Main Navigation')" class="px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-heading font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-spikeRed hover:bg-spikeRedGlow text-white spike-glow transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5">
          Join Free Preview
        </button>

        <!-- Mobile Drawer Toggle -->
        <button id="mobileMenuBtn" class="lg:hidden text-slate-300 hover:text-white p-2" aria-label="Toggle Navigation">
          <i data-lucide="menu" class="w-5 h-5"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Mobile Drawer Menu -->
    <div id="mobileMenu" class="hidden lg:hidden bg-obsidianElevated border-b border-borderDark px-5 py-5 space-y-3.5">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <p class="text-xs font-bold text-white">1 MATUNOG DISTRICT (1CMA)</p>
          <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">AIA Philippines Incubation Hub</p>
        </div>
        <span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-versaCyan/15 text-versaCyan font-mono">Versa Engine</span>
      </div>
      <a href="#audiences" class="block py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()">Tailored Venture Tracks</a>
      <a href="#diagnostic" class="block py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()">60s Venture Diagnostic</a>
      <a href="#ladder" class="block py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()">SPIKE / RA-SPIKE Pathway</a>
      <a href="#ecosystem" class="block py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()">Versa Platform Ecosystem</a>
      <a href="#cma" class="block py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()">1CMA District Leadership</a>
      <div class="pt-2 flex gap-2">
        <button onclick="toggleMobileMenu(); openVideoModal()" class="w-1/2 py-2.5 rounded-xl glass-panel text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <i data-lucide="play" class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-spikeRed fill-spikeRed"></i>
          <span>60s Reel</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="toggleMobileMenu(); openModal('Mobile Navigation')" class="w-1/2 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-spikeRed text-white font-heading font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
          Apply Now
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <!-- ================= IMMERSIVE VIDEO HERO ================= -->
  <header class="relative min-h-[92vh] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden pt-20">
    
    <!-- Background Looping Cinema Video -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 z-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
      <video id="heroBgVideo" muted loop playsinline preload="none" class="w-full h-full object-cover scale-105 filter brightness-[0.55] contrast-[1.15]">
        <!-- High-res ambient looping video of modern creative boardrooms and founders -->
        <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-group-of-people-discussing-in-a-meeting-room-4819-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
      </video>
      <div class="absolute inset-0 hero-gradient-overlay"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Ambient SPIKE Starburst Rotation Glow -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 z-[1] pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center opacity-25">
      <svg class="w-[640px] h-[640px] text-spikeRed/30 animate-glow-spin" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="currentColor">
        <rect x="47" y="0" width="6" height="100" />
        <rect x="0" y="47" width="100" height="6" />
        <rect x="47" y="0" width="6" height="100" transform="rotate(45 50 50)" />
        <rect x="47" y="0" width="6" height="100" transform="rotate(-45 50 50)" />
      </svg>
    </div>

    <!-- Hero Content Layer -->
    <div class="relative z-10 max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 text-center pt-8 pb-16">
      
      <!-- Institutional Credentials Badge -->
      <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-obsidianElevated/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/80 mb-6 text-xs text-slate-300 shadow-xl">
        <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-spikeRed animate-ping"></span>
        <span>Incubation Gateway of <strong class="text-white">1 Matunog District</strong> · AIA Philippines</span>
      </div>

      <!-- Concise High-Impact Headline (Visual first, Low Verbosity) -->
      <h1 class="font-heading font-black text-4xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tight text-white leading-[1.08]">
        Build Your Enterprise. <br />
        <span class="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500 via-rose-400 to-amber-300">
          Own Your Future.
        </span>
      </h1>

      <!-- Short Punchy Sub-Hero Statement -->
      <p class="mt-6 text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl text-slate-300 max-w-2xl mx-auto font-normal leading-relaxed">
        Discover financial entrepreneurship with 1CMA in Cebu. Start with a free preview, build your financial knowledge, and explore your next career step through <strong class="text-white">The SPIKE Method</strong>.
      </p>

      <!-- Action Cluster -->
      <div class="mt-9 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 max-w-md mx-auto sm:max-w-none">
        <button onclick="openModal('Financial Entrepreneur Preview')" class="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-4 rounded-xl font-heading font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wider uppercase bg-spikeRed hover:bg-spikeRedGlow text-white spike-glow transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 group">
          <span>Join the Free Preview</span>
          <i data-lucide="arrow-right" class="w-4 h-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1"></i>
        </button>

        <button onclick="openVideoModal()" class="w-full sm:w-auto px-7 py-4 rounded-xl font-heading font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white glass-panel hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
          <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-spikeRed flex items-center justify-center">
            <i data-lucide="play" class="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-white fill-white ml-0.5"></i>
          </div>
          <span>Watch 60-Sec Intro Reel</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- Quick Metrics Strip with Versa & 1CMA Elements -->
      <div class="mt-14 pt-8 border-t border-slate-800/80 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-center">
        <div class="p-2 sm:p-3">
          <div class="font-heading font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-white">₱0</div>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Preview Registration Fee</p>
        </div>
        <div class="p-2 sm:p-3">
          <div class="font-heading font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-cmaGold">MDRT</div>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Global Practice Benchmark</p>
        </div>
        <div class="p-2 sm:p-3">
          <div class="font-heading font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-versaCyan">100%</div>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Cloud Practice Infrastructure</p>
        </div>
        <div class="p-2 sm:p-3">
          <div class="font-heading font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-white">1CMA</div>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Cebu Matunog Agency Hub</p>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Video Audio Controller (Corner UI) -->
    <div class="absolute bottom-5 right-5 z-20 hidden md:flex items-center gap-2 bg-obsidian/80 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-400">
      <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-neonMint"></span>
      <span class="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Cebu Studio Ambient</span>
      <button onclick="toggleHeroAudio()" id="heroAudioBtn" class="hover:text-white ml-1">
        <i data-lucide="volume-x" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
      </button>
    </div>
  </header>


  <!-- ================= FREE ENTRY JOURNEY (PRIMARY CONVERSION MESSAGE) ================= -->
  <section id="free-journey" class="py-16 sm:py-20 bg-obsidianElevated border-t border-borderDark" aria-labelledby="free-journey-title">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div class="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-10">
        <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[.2em] text-spikeRed">Your first step is free</span>
        <h2 id="free-journey-title" class="mt-3 text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-heading font-extrabold text-white">Explore. Learn. Grow.</h2>
        <p class="mt-3 text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-400">No need to decide on a new career today. Start by discovering the opportunity and building your financial knowledge.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 lg:gap-7">
        <article class="glass-panel rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-7 border border-slate-800 flex flex-col gap-4 glass-card-interactive">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="text-cmaGold text-xs font-mono font-bold">01 / DISCOVER</span><i data-lucide="compass" class="w-6 h-6 text-spikeRed"></i></div>
          <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-xl text-white">Join the Free Financial Entrepreneur Preview</h3>
          <p class="text-sm text-slate-400 leading-relaxed flex-1">See what financial entrepreneurs do, meet the 1CMA community, and explore whether the path fits you.</p>
          <button onclick="openModal('Financial Entrepreneur Preview')" class="w-full rounded-xl bg-spikeRed py-3 text-white font-heading font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">Reserve My Free Spot</button>

          1 Matunog District & AIA Philippines Confidential Privacy Standards Applied.
        </p>
      </form>

      <!-- Step 2 Form (Lightweight Profiling) -->
      <form id="step2Form" onsubmit="handleStep2Submit(event)" class="mt-6 space-y-4 hidden">
        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 mb-1">Current Milestone</label>
          <select id="candStatus" class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-obsidianSurface border border-slate-700 text-white text-sm focus:border-spikeRed focus:outline-none">
            <option value="Employed Corporate">Corporate Professional / Seeking Autonomy</option>
            <option value="Business Owner">Business Owner / Freelance Consultant</option>
            <option value="Parent">Parent Seeking Flexible Schedule</option>
            <option value="Student">Graduating Senior / University Student</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 mb-1">Preferred Interaction Mode</label>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <label class="p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-obsidianSurface flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:border-slate-500">
              <input type="radio" name="meetMode" value="Cebu District Hub" checked class="text-spikeRed">
              <span>In-Person (Cebu Hub)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-obsidianSurface flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:border-slate-500">
              <input type="radio" name="meetMode" value="Virtual Zoom" class="text-spikeRed">
              <span>Virtual (Zoom)</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
          <button type="button" onclick="backToStep1()" class="w-1/3 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slateDark text-slate-300 font-semibold text-xs hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all">
            Back
          </button>
          <button type="submit" class="w-2/3 py-3 rounded-xl bg-spikeRed hover:bg-spikeRedGlow text-white font-heading font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider spike-glow transition-all">
            Confirm Application
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <!-- Success Screen -->
      <div id="modalSuccess" class="hidden text-center py-6 space-y-4">
        <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-spikeRed/20 text-spikeRed mx-auto flex items-center justify-center border border-spikeRed/30 spike-glow">
          <i data-lucide="check" class="w-7 h-7"></i>
        </div>
        <h4 class="text-xl font-heading font-bold text-white">Prototype Form Completed</h4>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-300 max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed">
          This is a UI demonstration only. Your details were not submitted to Versa or 1CMA. Live registration will be enabled after backend integration.
        </p>
        <div class="p-3 bg-obsidianSurface rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          No email or SMS has been sent from this prototype.
        </div>
        <button onclick="closeModal()" class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slateDark hover:bg-slate-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold">
          Return to Portal
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      lucide.createIcons();
    });


    // Accessible, persistent color theme switch.
    (function() {
      const toggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
      const label = document.getElementById('themeToggleText');
      let saved = 'dark';
      try { saved = localStorage.getItem('spike-next-theme') || 'dark'; } catch (_) {}
      function applyTheme(theme) {
        const light = theme === 'light';
        document.body.classList.toggle('theme-light', light);
        document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = light ? 'light' : 'dark';
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(light));
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', light ? 'Switch to dark theme' : 'Switch to light theme');
        toggle.setAttribute('title', light ? 'Switch to dark theme' : 'Switch to light theme');
        if (label) label.textContent = light ? 'Light' : 'Dark';
        try { localStorage.setItem('spike-next-theme', theme); } catch (_) {}
      }
      applyTheme(saved);
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => applyTheme(document.body.classList.contains('theme-light') ? 'dark' : 'light'));
    })();
    // Mobile Menu
    const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');

    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
    });

    function toggleMobileMenu() {
      mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function scrollToDiagnostic() {
      const el = document.getElementById('diagnostic');
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Hero Audio Controls
    const heroBgVideo = document.getElementById('heroBgVideo');
    const heroAudioBtn = document.getElementById('heroAudioBtn');
    let isMuted = true;

    function toggleHeroAudio() {
      if (!heroBgVideo) return;
      isMuted = !isMuted;
      heroBgVideo.muted = isMuted;
      heroAudioBtn.innerHTML = isMuted 
        ? '<i data-lucide="volume-x" class="w-4 h-4"></i>' 
        : '<i data-lucide="volume-2" class="w-4 h-4 text-spikeRed"></i>';
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // Video Modal
    const videoModal = document.getElementById('videoModal');
    const modalVideoPlayer = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');

    let videoPreviousFocus = null;
    function openVideoModal() {
      videoPreviousFocus = document.activeElement;
      videoModal.classList.remove('hidden');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      if (modalVideoPlayer) {
        modalVideoPlayer.muted = true; // autoplay sound is blocked on most mobile browsers
        modalVideoPlayer.currentTime = 0;
        const attempt = modalVideoPlayer.play();
        if (attempt && typeof attempt.catch === 'function') attempt.catch(() => {
          // If autoplay is blocked, native video controls allow manual playback.
          const status = document.getElementById('videoAutoplayNote');
          if (status) status.textContent = 'Tap play to watch the introductory preview.';
        });
      }
      document.getElementById('videoCloseBtn').focus();
    }

    function closeVideoModal() {
      // Start muted ambient hero only after the foreground introduction is dismissed.
      const ambient = document.getElementById('heroBgVideo');
      if (ambient && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
        const ambientPlay = ambient.play();
        if (ambientPlay && typeof ambientPlay.catch === 'function') ambientPlay.catch(() => {});
      }
      videoModal.classList.add('hidden');
      if (modalVideoPlayer) { modalVideoPlayer.pause(); modalVideoPlayer.currentTime = 0; }
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      if (videoPreviousFocus && typeof videoPreviousFocus.focus === 'function') videoPreviousFocus.focus();
    }

    // Play the placeholder orientation clip immediately after page initialization.
    // Users can dismiss it or unmute using the native player controls.
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      openVideoModal();
      if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches && modalVideoPlayer) modalVideoPlayer.pause();
    });
    videoModal.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
      const focusable = [...videoModal.querySelectorAll('button, video[controls]')].filter(el => !el.disabled);
      if (!focusable.length) return;
      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable[0]) { event.preventDefault(); focusable.at(-1).focus(); }
      else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === focusable.at(-1)) { event.preventDefault(); focusable[0].focus(); }
    });

    // Diagnostic Tool Logic
    let diagnosticAnswers = {};

    function setQuizAnswer(key, value, nextStep) {
      diagnosticAnswers[key] = value;
      document.getElementById('q1').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('q2').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('q3').classList.add('hidden');

      if (nextStep === 2) {
        document.getElementById('q2').classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('quizStepText').innerText = 'STEP 2 OF 3: STRATEGIC AMBITION';
        document.getElementById('quizBar').style.width = '66%';
      } else if (nextStep === 3) {
        document.getElementById('q3').classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('quizStepText').innerText = 'STEP 3 OF 3: TIME COMMITMENT';
        document.getElementById('quizBar').style.width = '100%';
      }
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function completeQuizResult(trackOutcome) {
      diagnosticAnswers['trackResult'] = trackOutcome;
      document.getElementById('q3').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('quizStepText').innerText = 'DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETED';

      const resultBox = document.getElementById('qResult');
      resultBox.classList.remove('hidden');

      const titleEl = document.getElementById('resultTitle');
      if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = trackOutcome;
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function restartQuiz() {
      diagnosticAnswers = {};
      document.getElementById('qResult').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('q2').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('q3').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('q1').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('quizStepText').innerText = 'STEP 1 OF 3: CURRENT CAREER STAGE';
      document.getElementById('quizBar').style.width = '33%';
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // Signup Modal & Progressive Profiling
    const signupModal = document.getElementById('signupModal');
    let candidateRecord = {};

    function openModal(trackDefault = 'Gen Y Mid-Career Pivot') {
      signupModal.classList.remove('hidden');
      const interestSelect = document.getElementById('sessionInterest');
      if (interestSelect) {
        interestSelect.value = trackDefault === 'Financial Literacy Sessions' ? 'Financial Literacy Sessions' : trackDefault === 'SPIKE Learning Pathway' ? 'SPIKE Learning Pathway' : 'Financial Entrepreneur Preview';
      }
      const trackSelect = document.getElementById('candTrack');
      if (trackSelect) {
        for (let i = 0; i < trackSelect.options.length; i++) {
          if (trackSelect.options[i].value.includes(trackDefault) || trackDefault.includes(trackSelect.options[i].value)) {
            trackSelect.selectedIndex = i;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      document.getElementById('step1Form').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('step2Form').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalSuccess').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalBadge').innerText = 'STEP 1 OF 2: CONTACT DETAILS';
      document.getElementById('modalSub').innerText = 'Enter your information to receive the 1CMA onboarding packet.';
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function openModalWithTrackResult() {
      const outcome = diagnosticAnswers['trackResult'] || 'Accelerated Practice Builder';
      openModal(outcome);
    }

    function closeModal() {
      signupModal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function handleStep1Submit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      candidateRecord.name = document.getElementById('candName').value;
      candidateRecord.phone = document.getElementById('candPhone').value;
      candidateRecord.email = document.getElementById('candEmail').value;
      candidateRecord.track = document.getElementById('candTrack').value;
      candidateRecord.sessionInterest = document.getElementById('sessionInterest').value;

      document.getElementById('step1Form').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('step2Form').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalBadge').innerText = 'STEP 2 OF 2: PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND';
      document.getElementById('modalSub').innerText = 'Help us assign your dedicated 1CMA Practice Mentor.';
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function backToStep1() {
      document.getElementById('step2Form').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('step1Form').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalBadge').innerText = 'STEP 1 OF 2: CONTACT DETAILS';
    }

    function handleStep2Submit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      candidateRecord.milestone = document.getElementById('candStatus').value;
      candidateRecord.meetMode = document.querySelector('input[name="meetMode"]:checked')?.value || 'Cebu District Hub';

      document.getElementById('step2Form').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalSuccess').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalBadge').innerText = 'DEMO FLOW COMPLETED';
      document.getElementById('modalSub').innerText = '';
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // Modal dismiss listeners
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (!signupModal.classList.contains('hidden')) closeModal();
        if (!videoModal.classList.contains('hidden')) closeVideoModal();
      }
    });

    signupModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === signupModal) closeModal();
    });

    videoModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === videoModal) closeVideoModal();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
